panels.framing: extreme wide establishing shot of the city seen from the lab window, no people
panels.action: 霧中的信義區夜景，高樓刺入雲層
panels.extra: The window glass is beaded with condensation. The room interior is only a dark reflection at the frame edges.

cast.visible: back view, head and shoulders, face not visible
cast.pose: standing close to the window, one hand resting on the glass, looking out

panels.framing: medium shot from behind and slightly to the right, over the shoulder toward the foggy city

letters.text: 陳昱已經在這裡待了十六個小時。

cast.visible: right hand and wrist only, no face, no body
cast.pose: hand resting beside the cup, fingertips on the desk edge

panels.framing: macro close-up on a desk, very shallow depth of field
panels.action: 冷掉的美式，杯壁的油膜，背後螢幕透出琥珀色的失敗警示光
panels.extra: A paper cup of cold black americano, half full, a thin oily film on the surface. Behind it, out of focus, a monitor floods the desk with an amber warning glow. The coffee is long cold: absolutely no steam or vapour.

letters.text:
衝突檢測。又失敗了。
今天第十三次。

cast.pose: slumped back in his office chair, half turned toward someone behind him off-frame right
cast.face: Eyes half-lidded and dry, brows slightly drawn together (AU4 light), mouth relaxed. Tired, not upset.

letters.speaker: CHAR-CHENYU
letters.text: 彥廷，我覺得我們的衝突檢測邏輯有問題。

cast.pose: has just pulled his noise-cancelling headphones down around his neck, swivel chair turned toward camera
cast.face: Level, watchful gaze straight at the other man, no smile, lips closed. Monitor glow reflected on his glasses.

panels.framing: medium close-up, eye level, mirroring the previous panel
panels.action: 林彥廷摘下耳機，轉過椅子

letters.speaker: CHAR-LINYANTING
letters.text: 不是邏輯有問題。

letters.speaker: CHAR-LINYANTING
letters.text: 是前提有問題。

cast.visible: hand and forearm only, entering from frame right
cast.pose: holding a blue marker against the whiteboard

props.place: fills the frame, flat-on; the left two-thirds is clean empty white space

panels.framing: flat-on insert shot of the whiteboard
panels.action: 白板：兩個 AI 的意圖

letters.text:
AI_A：turn_light_red（保護行人）
AI_B：turn_light_green（救護車通行）

cast.pose: standing at the whiteboard, turned back toward the room, marker still in hand

cast.visible: back of head and shoulder, out-of-focus foreground at frame left edge

props.place: behind the standing man, out of focus

panels.framing: medium shot over the seated man's shoulder
panels.action: 林彥廷轉身，說出這一章的命題

letters.speaker: CHAR-LINYANTING
letters.text: 所以，衝突不是意圖本身的屬性——

letters.speaker: CHAR-LINYANTING
letters.text: 而是意圖與環境的關係。

cast.visible: hand only, holding an eraser that has just wiped the board
cast.pose: eraser lifting away from the board

props.place: fills the frame; a freshly erased smeared area in the center, now empty

panels.framing: flat-on insert shot of the whiteboard, same as the earlier insert
panels.action: 擦掉「控制的幻覺比失控更危險」，重寫

letters.text:
Transparency is Control
（透明就是控制）

cast.pose: standing at the water dispenser by the door, holding a small paper cup of water, not looking at the other man

panels.action: 林彥廷在飲水機旁喝水

letters.speaker: CHAR-LINYANTING
letters.text: 水管工，不需要知道誰在喝水。

letters.speaker: CHAR-LINYANTING
letters.text: 但他控制了閥門。

cast.pose: pointing at his monitor off-frame left with one long finger
cast.face: Eyes bright and stubborn, slight upper-lid raise (AU5 light), the faint start of a conviction smile at one corner of the mouth.

panels.framing: close-up, the monitor's cyan light strong on his face

letters.speaker: CHAR-CHENYU
letters.text: Hash 值沒有偏見。它是純粹的。

cast.visible: tight close-up on the lower half of his face and glasses
cast.face: One corner of the mouth lifts slowly (AU12 unilateral), eyes not joining the smile. Meaningful, not villainous.

panels.framing: extreme close-up, glasses catching a reflection of scrolling screen light

letters.speaker: CHAR-LINYANTING
letters.text:
純粹的正義。
我喜歡這個詞。

cast.pose: sitting on the floor by the window, back against the low sill, unwrapping a convenience-store rice ball
sitting beside him, taking a rice ball from his hand

props.place: far in the background, a tiny point through the window between their heads

panels.framing: wide two-shot from the side, the two men small against the huge foggy window
panels.action: 兩人並排吃御飯糰，看霧中的城市

letters.speaker: CHAR-LINYANTING
letters.text: 鮭魚口味 sold out。我買了鮪魚。

letters.speaker: CHAR-CHENYU
letters.text: 叛徒。

props.place: upper third, on the rooftop edge of the dark building across the street

panels.framing: telephoto shot of the dark building across the street, the tower beyond it fully swallowed by fog
panels.extra: The supertall tower is completely invisible, erased by fog — only grey-white mist where it stood. The red light sits on the NEAR building's rooftop edge, not on any tower.

letters.text:
透明化之後呢？
誰來看？

cast.visible: full-body silhouette from behind, no face
cast.pose: standing at the window, raising one hand in a small wave toward the red light outside

props.place: through the window, roughly level with his raised hand

panels.framing: wide shot from the back of the dark lab, his silhouette against the window
panels.action: 陳昱對紅點揮手——一個無法被完美解析的動作

letters.text: 一個錯誤。
而未來，還沒有到來。
